name: Generic Profile: Raster thresholding
abstract: Divides the cells of a single-band raster into two classes at a threshold that the operation determines from the raster's values, and returns the upper class as a binary mask. One single-band Raster input, one Binary mask output.

sources.title: OGC 14-065 WPS 2.0.2 Interface Standard Corrigendum 2, §7.5.2 Generic Process Profile
